steps.note: the API built this case's state

Add the required RFQ line item.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Add a participant while deliberately leaving the event with zero bids.
Publish the RFQ without submitting any vendor bids.
Attempt the Request Best Offers action and require Procol to show that it is disabled or refuses because no vendor bids exist.
